why: Ends the profile's block at the FIRST closing brace instead of its own. Today every profile in ai-profiles.json is flat, so this mutation is invisible against the shipped file -- it only bites once a profile gains a nested object, at which point the sweep would silently patch a truncated block or the wrong field. The fixture in the test carries that nested case deliberately, so the guard fails now rather than on the day the file changes.
killedBy: patchProfileField: one profile, and only that one finds the profile s real closing brace, not the first one
